notes: §2002:13.16.38.2 SR6: the digit positions described by character-string-1 range from 1 through 31. A floating-point edited character-string-1 is both parts (§2002:13.16.38.3 GR12b) and the exponent's 9s are digit positions (§2002:13.16.38.4 ER8), so at COBOL-2002 AnalyzeFloatEdited refuses significand + exponent digits above 31 (COBOL1658); +9(29)E+999 (32) is refused, +9(27).9E+999 (31) accepted. From COBOL-2014 SR12 bounds the significand alone (36, row FloatEditedPictureWideBounds, VCR 7.118). The fixed-point arms already refuse 32 digit positions at 2002 (COBOL0801) (PB5712, review R1-1).
